post.summary: Add a source (file upload, URL or pasted text)
post.description: Multipart (`file`, optional `name`, `mode`) or JSON (`{url, pastedText?, name?, mode?}` or `{text, name, mode?}`). Files: PDF (page and size limits from settings) or UTF-8 text, checked by content. A URL is fetched by the server (https, public addresses only); if that fails the response is 422 `url-fetch-failed` and the client can resend the URL with `pastedText`.
